title: Add OpenTelemetry tracing and structured log export

context.summary: Add OTLP tracing and structured log export across runtime operations.
context.background: Public self-host deployments need correlation across API, worker, storage, model and vector operations.

in: Add OpenTelemetry configuration and OTLP exporter support.
Create spans for API requests, jobs, stages, model calls, storage operations and vector operations.
Propagate correlation IDs across API and worker jobs.
Add structured log export documentation and collector example.
Remove TASK-102-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.

acceptance_criteria: OTLP tracing can be enabled through config without code changes.
Trace spans include safe operation metadata and correlation IDs.
Worker jobs continue traces from enqueue context where available.
Docs include a local collector example.

manual_checks: Confirm traces and logs do not contain raw document content or secrets.

risks: Tracing must degrade cleanly when the collector is unavailable.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
